citations.narrative:
The current flooring for the whelping box enclosures do not protect the dogs feet and legs from injury. Several of the
whelping enclosures (WB33, WB53 and WB55) have coated wire mesh flooring that is allowing the puppies feet to fall
through the wire mesh. This is a potential hazard which could lead to injury of their feet or legs. Per this regulation, floors
that are wire mesh must not allow dogs feet to fall through. This needs to be addressed for the safety of the puppies.
Correct by: Aug 7, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
